draft.emotion: matter-of-fact, describing something ordinary and familiar
notes: Pork is more specifically called 豚肉 (butaniku), though 豚 alone is often used on menus and in dish names (such as 豚バラ, 'pork belly').
In some compounds, 豚 is read とん (ton), as in とんかつ (tonkatsu, 'pork cutlet') and 豚汁 (tonjiru, 'pork miso soup', also read butajiru).
